english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken expression for moving or facing northward.
This is the all-purpose way to express movement or direction towards the north.

examples.english: We’re walking north; the beach is that way.
examples.traditional: 我哋向北行，嗰邊先係海邊。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoeng3 bak1 haang4 go2 bin1 sin1 hai6 hoi2 bin1

examples.english: We walk northward along this road and reach North Point.
examples.traditional: 我哋沿住呢條路向北行，就到北角喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyun4 zyu6 ni1 tiu4 lou6 hoeng3 bak1 haang4 zau6 dou3 bak1 gok3 laa3
